analysis: Documentation-only PR. docs/developer/test.md adds a 'Startup Performance Recovery' section (head lines 53-88) describing synthetic tests for startup health-check calibration, plus MiMo FP32 preflight-refusal fixture notes (head lines 45-51) and bumps the date stamp. docs/operations/provider-release.md patch (hunk @@ -14,8 +15) records ProviderCore.version prepared as 0.9.21, v0.9.20 published 2026-10-12, and a dependency pin to mlx-swift-lm #305. No source, workflow, secret, entitlement, signing or registration behavior changed. I found no change to TB-002/TB-011 gates, App Attest authorization lifetimes, release-key handling (A-005/A-011), or the official-build registration flow. The documented calibration behavior (bounded native bootstrap, customer preemption, excluding startup timings from throughput learning) is a performance/capacity-reporting matter. It could touch capacity or heartbeat values the coordinator consumes, but the code is not in this diff, so no security conclusion can be drawn. Follow-up reviewers should check, if the corresponding source PR is supplied, that calibration cannot starve customer work or let a provider inflate its self-reported throughput (T-029, T-007 class). The new text states that synthetic timings prove state transitions only, not fleet recovery, which is an appropriately scoped claim. The dependency pin to a merged mlx-swift-lm PR is stated, but the exact submodule SHA is not visible here.
